lead.claim: Assess stride time variability at discharge to predict falls in stroke patients.
lead.context: Why this matters: This prospective cohort study looked at how stride time variability at discharge predicts fall risk within 6 months after discharge in stroke patients.

supporting.claim: Ultrasound improves injection accuracy and may offer short-term relief at some sites.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This scoping review examined the efficacy of ultrasound-guided injections versus landmark-guided injections in musculoskeletal practice.

supporting.claim: Combine decision principles with qualitative triage for high-performance sport support.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This narrative review proposes a framework for integrated decision-making in high-performance sport support systems.

supporting.claim: Can routine physical function assessments predict dementia risk in older adults?
supporting.context: Why this matters: This commentary suggests routine assessment of gait speed, grip strength, and frailty may identify older adults at increased risk of dementia.

supporting.claim: Prioritize self-management and workplace involvement for low back pain rehab.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This group concept mapping study identified stakeholder priorities for rehabilitation for people on sick leave due to low back pain.
